questions.q: What combination is required on a secondary replica for SQL Server AG automatic failover?
options: ASYNCHRONOUS_COMMIT with MANUAL failover
SYNCHRONOUS_COMMIT availability mode and AUTOMATIC failover mode
Any readable secondary with the AG listener configured
A cloud witness plus Node Majority quorum
questions.explain: Automatic failover requires both SYNCHRONOUS_COMMIT and AUTOMATIC on the target secondary; the AG then promotes the synchronous secondary with the most hardened log sequence.

questions.q: How does the SQL Server health lease work for cluster failover decisions?
options: sp_server_diagnostics runs on demand when a DBA calls it
The AG listener polls each replica hourly
The cluster waits indefinitely for diagnostics to return
sp_server_diagnostics reports instance health on a repeating interval (default one-third of the lease timeout, 20s default); if it reports unhealthy or stops reporting, the cluster initiates failover
questions.explain: The lease prevents a frozen SQL Server from holding cluster resources while unable to serve writes; HEALTH_CHECK_TIMEOUT (30s in the example) bounds how long the cluster waits before declaring a replica unhealthy.

questions.q: Per the chapter's decision matrix, when does the autonomous HA system act?
options: When the aggregate signal crosses a confidence threshold: at least two High-weight signals, or one High plus two Medium
On any single failed TCP health check
Only when all five signals agree
Every time replication lag exceeds 5 seconds
questions.explain: Requiring a constellation of weighted signals — TCP failures, redo-queue lag, quorum votes, throughput drops, OS process state — prevents failover storms from transient network blips.

questions.q: In the forced-failover sequencing, what is the mandatory order of operations?
options: Promote first, fence the old primary second
Fencing is optional for synchronous replicas
Confirm quorum majority, confirm fencing of the former primary, then execute the promotion — the fence must complete before promotion
Move the AG listener before confirming quorum
questions.explain: Promotion only proceeds after the fence is confirmed; a failed fence halts the sequence rather than risking dual primaries, since promoting first and fencing second is architecturally unsafe.

Zero data loss under automatic failover: a transaction cannot commit until the required secondaries have hardened it
Automatic election of a new witness
Read-only routing during failover
questions.explain: The setting is the RPO gate — combined with SYNCHRONOUS_COMMIT, it ensures at least one secondary is synchronous so automatic failover never loses acknowledged writes.
